messages:
Evan: hi all, first day! M2 Mac, trying to bootstrap per handbook. Installed brew + asdf but node/builds failing and brew isn't on PATH until I restart terminal. quick tips?

Kira: welcome Evan! Add brew to ~/.zprofile: `eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"` and `export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH` so it takes effect immediately.

Evan: thanks. asdf node plugin says it needs GPG keys, getting `gpg: no valid OpenPGP data found`.

InfraBot: Install gnupg via brew then run the node plugin import helper: `brew install gnupg` then `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring`. If behind corp VPN, set `GPG_TTY=$(tty)` first.

Jules: also run `asdf reshim nodejs` after install. For python builds ensure Xcode CLI tools: `xcode-select --install`. If you prefer, use `brew install python@3.11` to skip compilation.

Evan: solid, fixed. One more: where do we store NO_PROXY/env secrets?

InfraBot: keep them local: `~/.envs/shared` and use direnv to `source_env ~/.envs/shared` from repo `.envrc`. Add `~/.envs` to global gitignore.

Evan: awesome, will add a mini checklist to #new-hires. thanks! :tada:
